summary: Household: married couple, 5 people, Alaska, no children under 18, about $300,000/year from work, someone with a disability (wife's back condition). Likely: Medicaid (est. $16,030-$22,820/year if eligible). Worth checking: ACA premium tax credit (est. $10,470-$15,790/year) and SSI (est. $6,740-$10,940/year). Earned income tax credit could not be judged from these answers; the household can apply or call 211 to check. These are screening estimates, not eligibility decisions; apply through each official programme. Immigration status was not asked and can change eligibility.
